cohort: The study included 92 patients who had a previous caesarean section, categorized into case and control groups based on VBAC success, and age-matched, from Abdul Wahab Sjahranie Hospital Samarinda East Borneo.
finding: A higher number of previous deliveries (parity of 2-3 times) was significantly correlated with successful Vaginal Birth After Cesarean (VBAC).
mod_finding: A higher parity (2-3 times) significantly increased the odds of successful Vaginal Birth After Cesarean (VBAC) (OR=17.727).
